about: E: period level ranges, period giver, giver names and item names in the task text

entries.why: 35-41 is the patch 1.92 (2008) range ('Per patch 1.92 ... can now be turned in between levels 35 and 41'), so players at the boogeys' level (25-30) could not turn in; 2002-03 comments show a lower range (a level 42 got no XP, Oct 2002); Min = item level 28 (as in 176 of 227 kill tasks), 9-level spread like the other Classic 20s/30s tasks (104 22-31, 105 30-39, 109 27-36)
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 449 Glowing Soul Gem -- Kill Task, comments Oct 18 2002 and Jun 26 2003

entries.why: Ice Creature Corpse task was 37-41; Allakhazam and Uthgard both give 39-43
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 457 (Min 39 Max 43); Uthgard item 7648 Ice Creature Corpse (Jordan of Svealand East, Minimum Level 39 Maximum Level 43)

entries.why: Drakulv Scale task was 41-47; Allakhazam and both Uthgard records give 41-43
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 375 (Min 41 Max 43); Uthgard items 5276 and 7730 (Nikgor, Minimum Level 41 Maximum Level 43)

entries.why: Cultist Staff task was 31-36, below its item level 34; the period page gives Min 34 (Wayback capture 2004-10-13, page last updated Oct 2003) and the Allakhazam page 34-40
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 620 Cultist Staves -- Kill Task (Wayback 2004-10-13: Min Level 34; live page Min 34 Max 40)

entries.why: Blood Red Berry Wine task sat on Lenia Fletcher; the period giver is Allia Fletcher of Castle Sauvage, who stands next to Lenia in region 1 (Lenia keeps her period task 129 Decorative Arrows)
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 421 'Talk to Allia Fletcher in Castle Sauvage'; Uthgard item 6756 'Allia Fletcher of Forest Sauvage is offering a reward'; CapnBry Allia Fletcher zone 11 20336,59913
